metadata.title: Java 8 JVM Flags
metadata.description: Graph representation of JVM flags organized by category

nodes.label: -version
nodes.description: Prints the product version to stdout and exits.

nodes.label: -showversion
nodes.description: Prints version information to stderr when the JVM starts.

nodes.label: -help
nodes.description: Prints a summary of standard command-line options and exits.

nodes.label: -X
nodes.description: Prints help on all non-standard (-X) options and exits.

nodes.label: -XX:+PrintFlagsFinal
nodes.description: Prints the final values of all VM flags after argument parsing and exits.

nodes.label: -XX:+UnlockDiagnosticVMOptions
nodes.description: Unlocks options intended for JVM diagnosis and troubleshooting.

nodes.label: -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions
nodes.description: Unlocks options that are experimental and may change or be removed.

nodes.label: -Xms<size>
nodes.description: Sets the initial size of the Java heap (same as -XX:InitialHeapSize).

nodes.label: -Xmx<size>
nodes.description: Sets the maximum size of the Java heap (same as -XX:MaxHeapSize).

nodes.label: -XX:InitialHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Sets the initial Java heap size in bytes; equivalent to -Xms.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Sets the maximum Java heap size in bytes; equivalent to -Xmx.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCompressedOops
nodes.description: Uses 32-bit object references when the heap is under ~32 GB to save memory.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCompressedClassPointers
nodes.description: Stores class metadata in a separate compressed region to reduce footprint.

nodes.label: -XX:MetaspaceSize=<size>
nodes.description: Initial threshold at which a GC is triggered to reclaim metaspace.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=<size>
nodes.description: Upper limit on native memory used for class metadata (metaspace).

nodes.label: -XX:CompressedClassSpaceSize=<size>
nodes.description: Maximum size of the compressed class space used with compressed class pointers.

nodes.label: -XX:MinMetaspaceFreeRatio=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum percentage of metaspace that must be free after a GC.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxMetaspaceFreeRatio=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum percentage of metaspace that may be free after a GC.

nodes.label: -Xss<size>
nodes.description: Sets the thread stack size (same as -XX:ThreadStackSize).

nodes.label: -XX:ThreadStackSize=<kb>
nodes.description: Stack size in kilobytes for each Java thread.

nodes.label: -XX:VMThreadStackSize=<kb>
nodes.description: Stack size for VM internal threads.

nodes.label: -XX:CompilerThreadStackSize=<kb>
nodes.description: Stack size for JIT compiler threads.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseG1GC (available, not default)
nodes.description: Enables the Garbage-First (G1) garbage collector.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSerialGC
nodes.description: Uses the single-threaded Serial collector for young and old generations.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseParallelGC
nodes.description: Uses parallel threads for young-generation collection (Throughput collector).

nodes.label: -XX:+UseParallelOldGC
nodes.description: Uses parallel threads for old-generation collection with Parallel GC.

nodes.label: -XX:ParallelGCThreads=<n>
nodes.description: Number of threads used for parallel young or old generation GC.

nodes.label: -XX:ConcGCThreads=<n>
nodes.description: Number of threads for concurrent GC work (e.g. G1 or ZGC concurrent phases).

nodes.label: -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=<ms>
nodes.description: Soft target for maximum GC pause time in milliseconds (G1 and others).

nodes.label: -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=<size>
nodes.description: Size of each G1 heap region; must be a power of two between 1 MB and 32 MB.

nodes.label: -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=<n>
nodes.description: Heap occupancy percent that triggers concurrent marking in G1.

nodes.label: -XX:G1ReservePercent=<n>
nodes.description: Percentage of heap reserved as a false ceiling to reduce promotion failures.

nodes.label: -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=<n>
nodes.description: Allowed reclaimable garbage in old regions before mixed GC is considered.

nodes.label: -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=<n>
nodes.description: Target number of old regions collected per mixed G1 GC cycle.

nodes.label: -XX:G1NewSizePercent=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum young generation size as a percentage of the heap.

nodes.label: -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum young generation size as a percentage of the heap.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseTLAB
nodes.description: Enables thread-local allocation buffers for faster object allocation.

nodes.label: -XX:TLABSize=<bytes>
nodes.description: Target size of each thread-local allocation buffer.

nodes.label: -XX:MinTLABSize=<bytes>
nodes.description: Minimum allowed TLAB size when resizing.

nodes.label: -XX:TLABWasteTargetPercent=<n>
nodes.description: Target percentage of TLAB space that may be wasted at refill.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseStringDeduplication
nodes.description: Enables G1 string deduplication to share identical char arrays (G1 only).

nodes.label: -XX:StringDeduplicationAgeThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum age of a string before it is considered for deduplication.

nodes.label: -XX:+DisableExplicitGC
nodes.description: Ignores calls to System.gc() and Runtime.getRuntime().gc().

nodes.label: -XX:+ExplicitGCInvokesConcurrent
nodes.description: Makes System.gc() trigger a concurrent GC cycle instead of a full stop-the-world GC.

nodes.label: -Xint
nodes.description: Forces interpreted-only execution; disables the JIT compiler.

nodes.label: -Xcomp
nodes.description: Forces compilation of every method on first invocation (no interpretation tier).

nodes.label: -Xmixed
nodes.description: Uses both interpretation and compilation (default execution mode).

nodes.label: -XX:+TieredCompilation
nodes.description: Enables the tiered compilation system with client and server compiler levels.

nodes.label: -XX:TieredStopAtLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Stops tiered compilation at the given level (1–4).

nodes.label: -XX:CompileThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Number of method invocations before compilation at a given tier.

nodes.label: -XX:CICompilerCount=<n>
nodes.description: Number of compiler threads for tiered or server compilation.

nodes.label: -Xbatch
nodes.description: Disables background compilation; compiles in the invoking thread.

nodes.label: -XX:+BackgroundCompilation
nodes.description: Allows compilation to run in background compiler threads (default on).

nodes.label: -XX:MaxInlineSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum bytecode size of a method inlined by the JIT.

nodes.label: -XX:FreqInlineSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum bytecode size for frequently called methods to be inlined.

nodes.label: -XX:InlineSmallCode=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum native code size for a callee inlined into a caller.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxInlineLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum depth of nested method inlining.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxRecursiveInlineLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum depth of recursive method inlining.

nodes.label: -XX:+DoEscapeAnalysis
nodes.description: Enables escape analysis to eliminate redundant allocations and locks.

nodes.label: -XX:+EliminateAllocations
nodes.description: Removes heap allocations for non-escaping objects when escape analysis succeeds.

nodes.label: -XX:+EliminateLocks
nodes.description: Removes lock operations on objects proven not to escape.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseAES
nodes.description: Enables hardware-accelerated AES cipher implementations when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseAESIntrinsics
nodes.description: Uses intrinsics for AES encryption and decryption in supported crypto providers.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSHA
nodes.description: Enables hardware-accelerated SHA implementations when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCRC32Intrinsics
nodes.description: Uses CPU intrinsics for CRC32 calculation in java.util.zip.

nodes.label: -XX:InitialCodeCacheSize=<size>
nodes.description: Initial size of the code cache holding JIT-compiled native code.

nodes.label: -XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=<size>
nodes.description: Maximum size reserved for the code cache.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCodeCacheFlushing
nodes.description: Allows unused compiled code to be flushed when the code cache is full.

nodes.label: -XX:+SafepointTimeout
nodes.description: Logs or handles JVM threads that fail to reach a safepoint within the delay.

nodes.label: -XX:SafepointTimeoutDelay=<ms>
nodes.description: Milliseconds a thread may be late to a safepoint before timeout handling.

nodes.label: -Xshare:on
nodes.description: Uses class data sharing (CDS) when a shared archive is available.

nodes.label: -Xshare:off
nodes.description: Disables class data sharing.

nodes.label: -Xshare:auto
nodes.description: Uses CDS only if a compatible shared archive exists (default).

nodes.label: -XX:SharedArchiveFile=<file>
nodes.description: Path to a shared classes archive for CDS.

nodes.label: -Xverify:all
nodes.description: Verifies all bytecode in loaded classes (slower startup).

nodes.label: -Xverify:none
nodes.description: Disables bytecode verification (not recommended for production).

nodes.label: -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError
nodes.description: Creates a heap dump file when an OutOfMemoryError is thrown.

nodes.label: -XX:HeapDumpPath=<path>
nodes.description: Directory or file path for heap dumps written by the JVM.

nodes.label: -XX:ErrorFile=<file>
nodes.description: File where fatal error reports (hs_err_pid files) are written.

nodes.label: -XX:OnError=<cmd>
nodes.description: Command or script to run when the JVM encounters a fatal error.

nodes.label: -XX:OnOutOfMemoryError=<cmd>
nodes.description: Command or script to run when an OutOfMemoryError occurs.

nodes.label: -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError
nodes.description: Exits the JVM immediately when an OutOfMemoryError is thrown.

nodes.label: -XX:+CrashOnOutOfMemoryError
nodes.description: Crashes the JVM (abort) on OutOfMemoryError instead of catching it.

nodes.label: -XX:NativeMemoryTracking=off|summary|detail
nodes.description: Tracks native memory usage (off, summary, or detail); has runtime overhead.

nodes.label: -XX:+PrintNMTStatistics
nodes.description: Prints native memory tracking summary at JVM shutdown.

nodes.label: -Djava.security.policy=<file>
nodes.description: Sets the security policy file for the SecurityManager.

nodes.label: -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8
nodes.description: Default character encoding used by the JVM (e.g. UTF-8).

nodes.label: -Duser.timezone=UTC
nodes.description: Default time zone ID used by java.util.Date and related APIs.

nodes.label: -Djava.io.tmpdir=<path>
nodes.description: Default directory for temporary files created by the JVM.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseConcMarkSweepGC
nodes.description: Uses the Concurrent Mark Sweep (CMS) garbage collector.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSInitiatingOccupancyFraction=<n>
nodes.description: Sets the occupancy fraction that triggers a CMS collection cycle.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSParallelRemarkEnabled
nodes.description: Enables parallel remark phase for the Concurrent Mark Sweep collector.

nodes.label: -verbose:gc
nodes.description: Enables verbose garbage collection logging to stdout.

nodes.label: -XX:+PrintGCDetails
nodes.description: Prints detailed information for each garbage collection event.

nodes.label: -XX:+PrintGCTimeStamps
nodes.description: Prints a timestamp at each garbage collection event.

nodes.label: -Xloggc:<file>
nodes.description: Redirects GC logging output to the specified file.

nodes.label: -XX:PermSize=<size>
nodes.description: Sets the initial size of the permanent generation heap.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxPermSize=<size>
nodes.description: Sets the maximum size of the permanent generation heap.

nodes.label: -Djava.security.manager
nodes.description: Enables the Java security manager for the application.

nodes.label: -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=<n>
nodes.description: Specify the CPU count the VM should use and report as active.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizeDecrementScaleFactor=<n>
nodes.description: Adaptive size scale down factor for shrinking.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizeMajorGCDecayTimeScale=<n>
nodes.description: Time scale over which major costs decay.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePausePolicy=<n>
nodes.description: Policy for changing generation size for pause goals.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePolicyCollectionCostMargin=<n>
nodes.description: If collection costs are within margin, reduce both by full delta.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePolicyInitializingSteps=<n>
nodes.description: Number of steps where heuristics is used before data is used.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePolicyOutputInterval=<n>
nodes.description: Collection interval for printing information; zero means never.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePolicyWeight=<n>
nodes.description: Weight given to exponential resizing, between 0 and 100.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizeThroughPutPolicy=<n>
nodes.description: Policy for changing generation size for throughput goals.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveTimeWeight=<n>
nodes.description: Weight given to time in adaptive policy, between 0 and 100.

nodes.label: -XX:+AdjustConcurrency
nodes.description: Call thr_setconcurrency at thread creation time to avoid LWP starvation on MP systems (for Solaris Only).

nodes.label: -XX:+AggressiveHeap
nodes.description: Optimize heap options for long-running memory intensive apps.

nodes.label: -XX:+AggressiveOpts
nodes.description: Enable aggressive optimizations - see arguments.cpp.

nodes.label: -XX:AliasLevel=<n>
nodes.description: 0 for no aliasing, 1 for oop/field/static/array split, 2 for class split, 3 for unique instances.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlignVector
nodes.description: Perform vector store/load alignment in loop.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocateInstancePrefetchLines=<n>
nodes.description: Number of lines to prefetch ahead of instance allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchDistance=<n>
nodes.description: Distance to prefetch ahead of allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchInstr=<n>
nodes.description: Prefetch instruction to prefetch ahead of allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchLines=<n>
nodes.description: Number of lines to prefetch ahead of array allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchStepSize=<n>
nodes.description: Step size in bytes of sequential prefetch instructions.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchStyle=<n>
nodes.description: 0 = no prefetch, 1 = prefetch instructions for each allocation, 2 = use TLAB watermark to gate allocation prefetch,.

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowJNIEnvProxy
nodes.description: Allow JNIEnv proxies for jdbx.

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowNonVirtualCalls
nodes.description: Obey the ACC_SUPER flag and allow invokenonvirtual calls.

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowParallelDefineClass
nodes.description: Allow parallel defineClass requests for class loaders registering as parallel capable.

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowUserSignalHandlers
nodes.description: Do not complain if the application installs signal handlers (Solaris & Linux only).

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysActAsServerClassMachine
nodes.description: Always act like a server-class machine.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysCompileLoopMethods
nodes.description: When using recompilation, never interpret methods containing loops.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysLockClassLoader
nodes.description: Require the VM to acquire the class loader lock before calling loadClass() even for class loaders registering as parallel capable.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch
nodes.description: Force all freshly committed pages to be pre-touched.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysRestoreFPU
nodes.description: Restore the FPU control word after every JNI call (expensive).

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysTenure
nodes.description: Always tenure objects in eden (ParallelGC only).

nodes.label: -XX:+AssertOnSuspendWaitFailure
nodes.description: Assert/Guarantee on external suspend wait failure.

nodes.label: -XX:+AssumeMP
nodes.description: Instruct the VM to assume multiple processors are available.

nodes.label: -XX:AutoBoxCacheMax=<n>
nodes.description: Sets max value cached by the java.lang.Integer autobox cache.

nodes.label: -XX:AutoGCSelectPauseMillis=<n>
nodes.description: Automatic GC selection pause threshold in milliseconds.

nodes.label: -XX:+AvoidUnalignedAccesses
nodes.description: Avoid generating unaligned memory accesses on architectures where they are costly.

nodes.label: -XX:BCEATraceLevel=<n>
nodes.description: How much tracing to do of bytecode escape analysis estimates.

nodes.label: -XX:BackEdgeThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Interpreter Back edge threshold at which an OSR compilation is invoked.

nodes.label: -XX:BaseFootPrintEstimate=<n>
nodes.description: Estimate of footprint other than Java Heap.

nodes.label: -XX:BiasedLockingBulkRebiasThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Threshold of number of revocations per type to try to rebias all objects in the heap of that type.

nodes.label: -XX:BiasedLockingBulkRevokeThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Threshold of number of revocations per type to permanently revoke biases of all objects in the heap of that type.

nodes.label: -XX:BiasedLockingDecayTime=<n>
nodes.description: Decay time (in milliseconds) to re-enable bulk rebiasing of a type after previous bulk rebias.

nodes.label: -XX:BiasedLockingStartupDelay=<n>
nodes.description: Number of milliseconds to wait before enabling biased locking.

nodes.label: -XX:+BindGCTaskThreadsToCPUs
nodes.description: Bind GCTaskThreads to CPUs if possible.

nodes.label: -XX:+BlockLayoutByFrequency
nodes.description: Use edge frequencies to drive block ordering.

nodes.label: -XX:BlockLayoutMinDiamondPercentage=<n>
nodes.description: Miniumum %% of a successor (predecessor) for which block layout a will allow a fork (join) in a single chain.

nodes.label: -XX:+BlockLayoutRotateLoops
nodes.description: Allow back branches to be fall throughs in the block layour.

nodes.label: -XX:BlockZeroingLowLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum size in bytes for using block zeroing instead of scalar stores.

nodes.label: -XX:+BranchOnRegister
nodes.description: Use Sparc V9 branch-on-register opcodes.

nodes.label: -XX:+BytecodeVerificationLocal
nodes.description: Enable the Java bytecode verifier for local classes.

nodes.label: -XX:+BytecodeVerificationRemote
nodes.description: Enable the Java bytecode verifier for remote classes.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1OptimizeVirtualCallProfiling
nodes.description: Use CHA and exact type results at call sites when updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileBranches
nodes.description: Profile branches when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileCalls
nodes.description: Profile calls when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileCheckcasts
nodes.description: Profile checkcasts when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileInlinedCalls
nodes.description: Profile inlined calls when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileVirtualCalls
nodes.description: Profile virtual calls when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1UpdateMethodData
nodes.description: Update MethodData*s in Tier1-generated code.

nodes.label: -XX:+CICompilerCountPerCPU
nodes.description: 1 compiler thread for log(N CPUs).

nodes.label: -XX:+CITime
nodes.description: Collect timing information for compilation.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSAbortSemantics
nodes.description: Whether abort-on-overflow semantics is implemented.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSAbortablePrecleanMinWorkPerIteration=<n>
nodes.description: (Temporary, subject to experimentation) Nominal minimum work per abortable preclean iteration.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSAbortablePrecleanWaitMillis=<n>
nodes.description: (Temporary, subject to experimentation) Time that we sleep between iterations when not given enough work per iteration.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSBitMapYieldQuantum=<n>
nodes.description: Bitmap operations should process at most this many bits between yields.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSBootstrapOccupancy=<n>
nodes.description: Percentage CMS generation occupancy at which to initiate CMS collection for bootstrapping collection stats.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSClassUnloadingEnabled
nodes.description: Whether class unloading enabled when using CMS GC.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSClassUnloadingMaxInterval=<n>
nodes.description: When CMS class unloading is enabled, the maximum CMS cycle count for which classes may not be unloaded.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSCleanOnEnter
nodes.description: Clean-on-enter optimization for reducing number of dirty cards.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSCompactWhenClearAllSoftRefs
nodes.description: Compact when asked to collect CMS gen with clear_all_soft_refs().

nodes.label: -XX:CMSConcMarkMultiple=<n>
nodes.description: Size (in cards) of CMS concurrent MT marking task.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSConcurrentMTEnabled
nodes.description: Whether multi-threaded concurrent work enabled (effective only if ParNewGC).

nodes.label: -XX:CMSCoordinatorYieldSleepCount=<n>
nodes.description: Number of times the coordinator GC thread will sleep while yielding before giving up and resuming GC.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSDumpAtPromotionFailure
nodes.description: Dump useful information about the state of the CMS old generation upon a promotion failure.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSEdenChunksRecordAlways
nodes.description: Always record eden chunks used for the parallel initial mark or remark of eden.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSExpAvgFactor=<n>
nodes.description: Percentage (0-100) used to weigh the current sample when computing exponential averages for CMS statistics.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSExtrapolateSweep
nodes.description: CMS: cushion for block demand during sweep.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSFullGCsBeforeCompaction=<n>
nodes.description: Number of CMS full collection done before compaction if > 0.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSIncrementalDutyCycle=<n>
nodes.description: Percentage (0-100) of CMS incremental mode duty cycle. If CMSIncrementalPacing is enabled, then this is just the initial value.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSIncrementalDutyCycleMin=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum percentage (0-100) of the CMS incremental duty cycle used when CMSIncrementalPacing is enabled.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSIncrementalMode
nodes.description: Whether CMS GC should operate in incremental mode.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSIncrementalOffset=<n>
nodes.description: Percentage (0-100) by which the CMS incremental mode duty cycle is shifted to the right within the period between young GCs.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSIncrementalPacing
nodes.description: Whether the CMS incremental mode duty cycle should be automatically adjusted.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSIncrementalSafetyFactor=<n>
nodes.description: Percentage (0-100) used to add conservatism when computing the duty cycle.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSIndexedFreeListReplenish=<n>
nodes.description: Replenish an indexed free list with this number of chunks.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSIsTooFullPercentage=<n>
nodes.description: An absolute ceiling above which CMS will always consider the unloading of classes when class unloading is enabled.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSLargeCoalSurplusPercent=<n>
nodes.description: CMS: the factor by which to inflate estimated demand of large block sizes to prevent coalescing with an adjoining block.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSLargeSplitSurplusPercent=<n>
nodes.description: CMS: the factor by which to inflate estimated demand of large block sizes to prevent splitting to supply demand for smaller blocks.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSLoopWarn
nodes.description: Warn in case of excessive CMS looping.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSMaxAbortablePrecleanLoops=<n>
nodes.description: (Temporary, subject to experimentation) Maximum number of abortable preclean iterations, if > 0.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSMaxAbortablePrecleanTime=<n>
nodes.description: (Temporary, subject to experimentation) Maximum time in abortable preclean (in milliseconds).

nodes.label: -XX:CMSOldPLABMax=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum size of CMS gen promotion LAB caches per worker per block size.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSOldPLABMin=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum size of CMS gen promotion LAB caches per worker per block size.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSOldPLABNumRefills=<n>
nodes.description: Nominal number of refills of CMS gen promotion LAB cache per worker per block size.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSOldPLABReactivityFactor=<n>
nodes.description: The gain in the feedback loop for on-the-fly PLAB resizing during a scavenge.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSOldPLABResizeQuicker
nodes.description: React on-the-fly during a scavenge to a sudden change in block demand rate.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSOldPLABToleranceFactor=<n>
nodes.description: The tolerance of the phase-change detector for on-the-fly PLAB resizing during a scavenge.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPLABRecordAlways
nodes.description: Always record survivor space PLAB boundaries (effective only if CMSParallelSurvivorRemarkEnabled).

nodes.label: -XX:CMSParPromoteBlocksToClaim=<n>
nodes.description: Number of blocks to attempt to claim when refilling CMS LAB's for parallel GC.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSParallelInitialMarkEnabled
nodes.description: Use the parallel initial mark.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSParallelSurvivorRemarkEnabled
nodes.description: Whether parallel remark of survivor space enabled (effective only if CMSParallelRemarkEnabled).

nodes.label: -XX:CMSPrecleanDenominator=<n>
nodes.description: CMS preclean convergence ratio denominator.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSPrecleanIter=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum number of precleaning iteration passes.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSPrecleanNumerator=<n>
nodes.description: CMS preclean convergence ratio numerator.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrecleanRefLists1
nodes.description: Preclean ref lists during (initial) preclean phase.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrecleanRefLists2
nodes.description: Preclean ref lists during abortable preclean phase.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrecleanSurvivors1
nodes.description: Preclean survivors during (initial) preclean phase.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrecleanSurvivors2
nodes.description: Preclean survivors during abortable preclean phase.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSPrecleanThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Do not iterate again if number of dirty cards is less than this.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrecleaningEnabled
nodes.description: Whether concurrent precleaning enabled.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrintChunksInDump
nodes.description: In a dump enabled by CMSDumpAtPromotionFailure, include more detailed information about the free chunks.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrintEdenSurvivorChunks
nodes.description: Print the eden and the survivor chunks used for the parallel initial mark or remark of the eden/survivor spaces.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSPrintObjectsInDump
nodes.description: In a dump enabled by CMSDumpAtPromotionFailure, include more detailed information about the allocated objects.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSRemarkVerifyVariant=<n>
nodes.description: Choose variant (1,2) of verification following remark.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSReplenishIntermediate
nodes.description: Replenish all intermediate free-list caches.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSRescanMultiple=<n>
nodes.description: Size (in cards) of CMS parallel rescan task.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSSamplingGrain=<n>
nodes.description: The minimum distance between eden samples for CMS (see above).

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSScavengeBeforeRemark
nodes.description: Attempt scavenge before the CMS remark step.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSScheduleRemarkEdenPenetration=<n>
nodes.description: The Eden occupancy percentage (0-100) at which to try and schedule remark pause.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSScheduleRemarkEdenSizeThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: If Eden size is below this, do not try to schedule remark.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSScheduleRemarkSamplingRatio=<n>
nodes.description: Start sampling eden top at least before young gen occupancy reaches 1/<ratio> of the size at which we plan to schedule remark.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSSmallCoalSurplusPercent=<n>
nodes.description: CMS: the factor by which to inflate estimated demand of small block sizes to prevent coalescing with an adjoining block.

nodes.label: -XX:CMSSmallSplitSurplusPercent=<n>
nodes.description: CMS: the factor by which to inflate estimated demand of small block sizes to prevent splitting to supply demand for smaller blocks.

nodes.label: -XX:+CMSSplitIndexedFreeListBlocks

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCMSCompactAtFullCollection
nodes.description: Use Mark-Sweep-Compact algorithm at full collections.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCMSInitiatingOccupancyOnly
nodes.description: Only use occupancy as a criterion for starting a CMS collection.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCRC32
nodes.description: Use hardware CRC32 instructions when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCompiler
nodes.description: Use Just-In-Time compilation.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCompilerSafepoints
nodes.description: Stop at safepoints in compiled code.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCondCardMark
nodes.description: Check for already marked card before updating card table.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCountedLoopSafepoints
nodes.description: Force counted loops to keep a safepoint.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCounterDecay
nodes.description: Adjust recompilation counters.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseDivMod
nodes.description: Use combined DivMod instruction if available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseDynamicNumberOfGCThreads
nodes.description: Dynamically choose the number of parallel threads parallel gc will use.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseFPUForSpilling
nodes.description: Spill integer registers to FPU instead of stack when possible.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseFastAccessorMethods
nodes.description: Use fast method entry code for accessor methods.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseFastEmptyMethods
nodes.description: Use fast method entry code for empty methods.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseFastJNIAccessors
nodes.description: Use optimized versions of Get<Primitive>Field.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseGCLogFileRotation
nodes.description: Rotate gclog files (for long running applications). It requires -Xloggc:<filename>.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseGCOverheadLimit
nodes.description: Use policy to limit of proportion of time spent in GC before an OutOfMemory error is thrown.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseGCTaskAffinity
nodes.description: Use worker affinity when asking for GCTasks.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseGHASHIntrinsics
nodes.description: Use intrinsics for GHASH versions of crypto.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseHeavyMonitors
nodes.description: Use heavyweight instead of lightweight Java monitors.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseHugeTLBFS
nodes.description: Use huge pages through hugetlbfs on Linux.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseInlineCaches
nodes.description: Use Inline Caches for virtual calls.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseInterpreter
nodes.description: Use interpreter for non-compiled methods.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseJumpTables
nodes.description: Use JumpTables instead of a binary search tree for switches.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLSE
nodes.description: Use ARM Large System Extensions atomic instructions when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLWPSynchronization
nodes.description: Use LWP-based instead of libthread-based synchronization (SPARC only).

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLargePages
nodes.description: Use large page memory.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLargePagesInMetaspace
nodes.description: Use large page memory in metaspace. Only used if UseLargePages is enabled.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLargePagesIndividualAllocation
nodes.description: Allocate large pages individually for better affinity.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLegacyJNINameEscaping
nodes.description: Use the original JNI name escaping scheme.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLockedTracing
nodes.description: Use locked-tracing when doing event-based tracing Deprecated: use FlightRecorder instead.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLoopCounter
nodes.description: Increment invocation counter on backward branch.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLoopInvariantCodeMotion
nodes.description: Simple loop invariant code motion for short loops during GVN.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLoopPredicate
nodes.description: Generate a predicate to select fast/slow loop versions.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMathExactIntrinsics
nodes.description: Enables intrinsification of various java.lang.Math functions.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMaximumCompactionOnSystemGC
nodes.description: Use maximum compaction in the Parallel Old garbage collector for a system GC.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMembar
nodes.description: (Unstable) Issues membars on thread state transitions.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMontgomeryMultiplyIntrinsic
nodes.description: Enables intrinsification of BigInteger.montgomeryMultiply().

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMontgomerySquareIntrinsic
nodes.description: Enables intrinsification of BigInteger.montgomerySquare().

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMulAddIntrinsic
nodes.description: Enables intrinsification of BigInteger.mulAdd().

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMultiplyToLenIntrinsic
nodes.description: Enables intrinsification of BigInteger.multiplyToLen().

nodes.label: -XX:+UseNUMA
nodes.description: Use NUMA if available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseNUMAInterleaving
nodes.description: Interleave memory across NUMA nodes if available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseNeon
nodes.description: Use ARM NEON SIMD instructions when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseOSErrorReporting
nodes.description: Let VM fatal error propagate to the OS (ie. WER on Windows).

nodes.label: -XX:+UseOnStackReplacement
nodes.description: Use on stack replacement, calls runtime if invoc. counter overflows in loop.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseOnlyInlinedBimorphic
nodes.description: Don't use BimorphicInlining if can't inline a second method.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseOprofile
nodes.description: Enable OProfile integration for performance monitoring.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseOptoBiasInlining
nodes.description: Generate biased locking code in C2 ideal graph.

nodes.label: -XX:+UsePSAdaptiveSurvivorSizePolicy
nodes.description: Use adaptive survivor sizing policies.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseParNewGC
nodes.description: Use parallel threads in the new generation.

nodes.label: -XX:+UsePerfData
nodes.description: Flag to disable jvmstat instrumentation for performance testing and problem isolation purposes.

nodes.label: -XX:+UsePopCountInstruction
nodes.description: Use population count instruction.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseRDPCForConstantTableBase
nodes.description: Use Sparc RDPC instruction for the constant table base.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSHA1Intrinsics
nodes.description: Use intrinsics for SHA-1 crypto hash function.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSHA256Intrinsics
nodes.description: Use intrinsics for SHA-224 and SHA-256 crypto hash functions.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSHA512Intrinsics
nodes.description: Use intrinsics for SHA-384 and SHA-512 crypto hash functions.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSHM
nodes.description: Use System V shared memory for selected JVM facilities.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSIMDForMemoryOps
nodes.description: Use SIMD instructions in generated array copy and memory moves.

nodes.label: -XX:UseSSE=<n>
nodes.description: Highest supported SSE instructions set on x86/x64.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSSE42Intrinsics
nodes.description: SSE4.2 versions of intrinsics.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSharedSpaces
nodes.description: Use shared spaces for metadata.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSignalChaining
nodes.description: Use signal-chaining to invoke signal handlers installed by the application (Solaris & Linux only).

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSquareToLenIntrinsic
nodes.description: Enables intrinsification of BigInteger.squareToLen().

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSuperWord
nodes.description: Transform scalar operations into superword operations.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseThreadPriorities
nodes.description: Use native thread priorities 0 : Normal.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseTypeProfile
nodes.description: Check interpreter profile for historically monomorphic calls.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseTypeSpeculation
nodes.description: Speculatively propagate types from profiles.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseVMInterruptibleIO
nodes.description: (Unstable, Solaris-specific) Thread interrupt before or with EINTR for I/O operations results in OS_INTRPT. The default value of this flag is true for JDK 6 and earlier.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseXMMForArrayCopy
nodes.description: Use SSE2 MOVQ instruction for Arraycopy.

nodes.label: -XX:+VMThreadHintNoPreempt
nodes.description: (Solaris only) Give VM thread an extra quanta.

nodes.label: -XX:VMThreadPriority=<n>
nodes.description: The native priority at which the VM thread should run (-1 means no change).

nodes.label: -XX:ValueMapInitialSize=<n>
nodes.description: Initial size of a value map.

nodes.label: -XX:ValueMapMaxLoopSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum size of a loop optimized by global value numbering.

nodes.label: -XX:ValueSearchLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Recursion limit in PhaseMacroExpand::value_from_mem_phi.

nodes.label: -XX:+VerifyMergedCPBytecodes
nodes.description: Verify bytecodes after RedefineClasses constant pool merging.

nodes.label: -XX:+VerifySharedSpaces
nodes.description: Verify shared spaces (false for default archive, true for archive specified by -XX:SharedArchiveFile).

nodes.label: -XX:WorkAroundNPTLTimedWaitHang=<n>
nodes.description: (Unstable, Linux-specific) avoid NPTL-FUTEX hang pthread_cond_timedwait.

nodes.label: -XX:YoungGenerationSizeIncrement=<n>
nodes.description: Adaptive size percentage change in young generation.

nodes.label: -XX:YoungGenerationSizeSupplement=<n>
nodes.description: Supplement to YoungedGenerationSizeIncrement used at startup.

nodes.label: -XX:YoungGenerationSizeSupplementDecay=<n>
nodes.description: Decay factor to YoungedGenerationSizeSupplement.

nodes.label: -XX:YoungPLABSize=<n>
nodes.description: Size of young gen promotion LAB's (in HeapWords).

nodes.label: -XX:+ZeroTLAB
nodes.description: Zero out the newly created TLAB.

nodes.label: -XX:hashCode=<n>
nodes.description: (Unstable) select hashCode generation algorithm.
